description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) features in PyTorch, focusing on training parity, parameter registration, sharding placement, activation checkpointing, custom forward methods, communication context sharing, multi-process behavior, and various advanced distributed training scenarios.

classes.name: TestFullyShardForwardInputs
classes.description: Tests for verifying input device movement and handling within FSDP when using fully_shard.

classes.name: TestFullyShardRegisteredParams
classes.description: Tests to ensure parameters are correctly registered after forward and backward passes.

classes.name: TestFullyShardCastAfterInit
classes.description: Tests the ability to cast modules to different dtypes after initialization.

classes.name: TestFullyShard1DTrainingCore
classes.description: Training parity tests for models sharded in 1D configuration, including shard_dim0 sharding.

classes.name: TestFullyShard1DTrainingCompose
classes.description: Tests for training with activation checkpointing and module grouping in a 1D setting.

classes.name: TestFullyShardShardPlacementFnMultiProcess
classes.description: Multi-process tests for shard placement functions with parameter sharding.

classes.name: TestFullyShardShardPlacementFnMultiThread
classes.description: Multi-threaded tests for shard placement with parameter and gradient sharding.

classes.name: TestFullyShardSharedParams
classes.description: Tests for shared parameter correctness and training parity when parameters are shared across modules.

classes.name: TestFullyShardGradientAccumulation
classes.description: Tests for gradient accumulation behavior, including communication via reduce-scatter and all-reduce operations.

classes.name: TestFullyShardNDTraining
classes.description: Tests for training across multi-dimensional device meshes with ND sharding, including parameter and activation sharding.

classes.name: TestFullyShardHSDP3DTraining
classes.description: Tests for 3D hierarchical sharding in multi-GPU setups.

classes.name: TestFullyShardHSDPTraining
classes.description: Tests for hierarchical sharding (HSDP), including checkpointing and offloading options.

classes.name: TestFullyShardCustomForwardMethod
classes.description: Verifies registration and correctness of custom forward methods for FSDP modules.

classes.name: TestFullyShardShareCommContext
classes.description: Tests sharing of communication contexts across multiple modules to optimize collective operations.

classes.name: TestFullyShardWorldSize1
classes.description: Special case tests for scenarios with a single GPU (world size = 1).

classes.name: TestFullyShardWorldSize1
classes.description: Tests for training parity and parameter sharding behavior when the world size is 1, including sharding on dimension 0 and verifying loss consistency.

classes.name: TestFullyShardCudaGraph
classes.description: Tests utilizing CUDA graphs with fully sharded models for efficiency and correctness in multi-GPU scenarios, including graph replay and output consistency checks.
